summary: Sheet #32 Notification/Alert/Messaging Center tested. Backend 15/17 pass, 1 CRITICAL fail (admin broadcast bypasses user prefs), 1 skipped (proposal endpoint shape unknown). Frontend UI verified: bell badge (unread=3), Notifications Center renders with all filter tabs (all/projects/safety/social/news), TEST_urgent card shows red ACTION REQUIRED banner, mark-all + prefs (cog) buttons present, deletes/filters have testIDs, Community tab labeled PRO-EARN. Emergency triage correctly creates safety+urgent notification. Urgent+safety override delivers even with promo=false & dnd=true (invariant honored). Admin non-admin gets 403. Campaigns list returns read_count/read_rate correctly. CRITICAL BUG: promo broadcast is delivered to a user who set promo=false because admin_broadcast writes docs directly to db.notifications instead of using push_notification helper that enforces prefs (server.py:3134-3140).

critical.issue: Bypasses push_notification helper and inserts docs directly, so user notification preferences (e.g. promo=false) are NOT honored for non-urgent, non-safety broadcasts. Violates stated invariant: 'PUT {promo:false} then a promo broadcast should NOT create a notification for that user.' Test test_promo_disabled_blocks_promo_broadcast FAILED. Fix: iterate users and call push_notification(...) per recipient (or filter q by prefs), preserving campaign_id in meta. Urgent+safety already always deliver so that path stays intact.

minor.issue: test_proposal_creates_client_project_notif skipped because /api/jobs (pro list) shape/route not confirmed; project-notification wiring (push_notification at server.py:1927, 1983, 2010, 2024) not covered by automated test in this pass. Endpoint responses look correct in code review; recommend main-agent quick sanity check via curl.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: admin_broadcast() at /app/backend/server.py:3121-3146 was implemented as a fast-path bulk insert using db.notifications.insert_many(docs) instead of delegating each recipient to push_notification() which enforces `if not override and not prefs.get(ntype, True): return None`. Because the override rule is only evaluated inside the helper, direct insert_many writes ignore users' notif_prefs. Reproduction: 1) PUT /api/notifications/preferences {promo:false} as demo_home; 2) POST /api/admin/notifications/broadcast {segment:all, ntype:promo, priority:normal}; 3) GET /api/notifications?filter=promo — the new promo notification IS present (should be absent). Urgent path is unaffected because urgent broadcasts already deliver unconditionally, matching the invariant. Mitigation: replace the bulk-insert branch in admin_broadcast with a per-user loop calling push_notification and count the non-None returns as `recipients` (campaign_id preserved in meta).
